title: Exchange for the shifted twisted unit of the projective line
statement: Let N>0, let A be a commutative ring killed by N, and let t be any normalized ordinary finite twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. For every f:Sprime->S between schemes where N is invertible, f-star of the shifted twisted unit A_S(1)[2]->Rq_*A_P(1)[2], followed by projective-line exchange and the shifted line comparison on P, equals the shifted line comparison on S followed by the shifted twisted unit on Sprime. This is an equation of single components; it asserts neither a Chern family nor a splitting.

Establish the composition formula for the transported object morphisms in arbitrary abelian categories before specializing to schemes. Shift by 2 using compatibility of the derived composition comparisons with shifts. Cancelling the comparison along one path gives the exact derived shifted-line square. proof.text: The exchange is by definition the right mate of the exact inverse-image square. The mate-unit identity, followed by the line transport square and naturality of the qprime-unit, gives the exact twisted-unit equation. A generic cancellation lemma then transports this equation through the exact/left-derived comparison, using the normalized units and shifted-line comparisons. This gives precisely the asserted equality of the original components. No exchange isomorphism or splitting is invoked.

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_twisted_unit_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {S' S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤))) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map (ordinaryFiniteP1Unit A N hA t S hS) ≫
        ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A f
          ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
          (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t
            (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) f)
            ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
              hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom)).hom =
      (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t f hS).hom ≫
        ordinaryFiniteP1Unit A N hA t S' hS'
